defects.summary: MECH-314b (uncertainty) and MECH-314c (LP) are Phase-1 BROADCAST SCALARS (ree_core/policy/structured_curiosity.py:40-41,101) -- one constant added uniformly across all K candidates -- while C2's DV (selected_action_class_entropy) is a pure function of the argmax sequence. A uniform additive constant cannot change an argmax (nor a softmax sample), so their c2 deltas of EXACTLY 0.0 are an arithmetic identity fixed before the run, independent of the claims' truth.

re_derive_brake.counting_convention: R1-R3 (distinct run_ids; latest adjudication supersedes; only recommended_epistemic_category == substrate_ceiling counts)
re_derive_brake.refusal_rationale: Another lettered same-claim ablation would return 0.0 DETERMINISTICALLY -- not probably, but as an arithmetic consequence of adding a constant to every candidate score. The re-test's result is knowable in advance without running it, making this the strongest possible instance of the loop the brake exists to stop. A DV swap alone is also not a viable escape: a uniform additive bonus is inert under argmax AND softmax, so no selection-level readout can rescue the Phase-1 implementation. A redesign testing a DIFFERENT mechanism (new EXQ number, different claim_ids) remains permitted.

The chain TERMINATED IN A PASS. MECH-314's decomposition into 314a/b/c is working as designed -- it returned a sharp, actionable answer (one child load-bearing, two structurally untestable). Recorded so the standing GOV-GRAN-1 scan sees a deliberate non-route rather than a dropped handoff.

learning_extracted: D3 triage has TWO rungs and the cheaper one is also the stronger -- take it FIRST. RUNG 1 executed-substrate identity (static): if the driver imports its substrate at module scope and runs one process with no dynamic reimport, sys.modules binds the code at process start and NO mid-run edit can reach execution -- the divergence is a RECORDING artefact of compute_substrate_hash re-reading the working tree per cell. RUNG 2 matched cross-boundary cells (empirical): compare all recorded fields of two cells straddling the boundary whose intended difference is separable; bit-identity on trajectory quantities exonerates regardless of what changed -- use when import structure is unknown, a restart is suspected, or rung 1 is inconclusive, and as corroboration otherwise (rung 1 PREDICTS the identity rung 2 measures). The sweep's severity ranking is a prior, not a verdict. Re-ranked in the 2026-07-20T07:25Z amendment; originally stated in the opposite order.

substrate_n_files movement does NOT rank D3 severity: V3-EXQ-778a (constant 129) and V3-EXQ-604c (90->91) are the same executed_substrate_identity artefact class despite opposite n_files behaviour. A file appearing on disk is not evidence it executed; any triage ladder keyed on n_files will mis-rank them.

A dirty tree defeats hash-based attribution but not empirical exoneration. Recomputing compute_substrate_hash at candidate commits is worth doing, but when substrate_n_files disagrees with the clean tree by a constant offset, attribution must be reported as corroborating only.

A broadcast scalar cannot be tested with an argmax-derived DV. This is a GENERAL vacuity pattern distinct from both known E3 pseudo-replication forms and from the vacuous_pass flag: the criterion is not degenerate, the arms are correctly plumbed, and the run legitimately PASSes -- yet two of its legs were arithmetic identities. Statically detectable: a manipulation invariant under the DV's own symmetry (here additive-constant invariance of an argmax) tested against that DV. Candidate for a lint in the /queue-experiment design-audit step.

The manifest's own readouts diagnosed the architecture: curiosity_bias_range equal to full precision while curiosity_bias_max_abs differs IS the broadcast-scalar signature. Recording both a range and a magnitude of the same quantity was decisive; the pair should be kept.

A repaired readiness gate certifies only the channel it measures. The 604b->604c magnitude-to-range repair was correct and is not withdrawn, but it silently narrowed the gate's scope to the per-candidate channel. When a gate is re-pointed at a new statistic, re-check which arms it still certifies.
